description: This file defines the DeviceInterface interface, which specifies platform-specific utilities and database operations for devices, including storage access, database management, keychain handling, and reset functions.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Method to deinitialize or clean up resources.

methods.name: getRawStorageValue
methods.description: Retrieves a raw storage value by key.

methods.name: getJsonParsedRawStorageValue
methods.description: Retrieves and parses a raw storage value as JSON.

methods.name: setRawStorageValue
methods.description: Sets a raw storage value for a given key.

methods.name: removeRawStorageValue
methods.description: Removes a raw storage value by key.

methods.name: removeAllRawStorageValues
methods.description: Removes all raw storage values.

methods.name: openDatabase
methods.description: Opens or initializes a database for the given application identifier.

methods.name: getDatabaseLoadChunks
methods.description: Retrieves chunks of database load data based on options.

methods.name: clearAllDataFromDevice
methods.description: Clears all keychain and database data from the device.

methods.name: getAllDatabaseEntries
methods.description: Fetches all database entries for an application.

methods.name: getDatabaseEntries
methods.description: Fetches specific database entries by keys.

methods.name: saveDatabaseEntry
methods.description: Saves a single database entry.

methods.name: saveDatabaseEntries
methods.description: Saves multiple database entries.

methods.name: removeDatabaseEntry
methods.description: Removes a database entry by ID.

methods.name: removeAllDatabaseEntries
methods.description: Removes all database entries for an application.

methods.name: getNamespacedKeychainValue
methods.description: Retrieves a namespaced keychain value.

methods.name: setNamespacedKeychainValue
methods.description: Sets a namespaced keychain value.

methods.name: clearNamespacedKeychainValue
methods.description: Clears a namespaced keychain value.

methods.name: clearRawKeychainValue
methods.description: Clears raw keychain data.

methods.name: openUrl
methods.description: Opens a URL in the device's browser.

methods.name: performSoftReset
methods.description: Performs a soft reset of the device.

methods.name: performHardReset
methods.description: Performs a hard reset of the device.

methods.name: isDeviceDestroyed
methods.description: Checks if the device has been destroyed.
